title: 아까 봤는데요: -더니와 -던데로 본 일 말하기
objective: By the end, you can use -더니 to say what you saw and how it changed or turned out, and -던데 to give what you saw as background for a suggestion, question, or contrast.
summary: This worksheet compares -더니 and -던데, two endings for linking something you saw yourself to what came after it.

task.title: Choose, complete, and join
task.line: Ask yourself whether the second part tells a result or change (-더니) or a suggestion, question, or contrast (-던데). Then choose or write the right form.

forms.when: You saw something before, and now it is different. Add -더니 to the verb or adjective stem. With a noun, use 이더니.
forms.exampleMeaning: It was cloudy this morning, but it cleared up in the afternoon.

forms.when: You watched someone keep doing something, and you then saw the result. The second part tells what happened.
forms.means: "(I saw that) they did ..., and so ..."
forms.example: 동생이 매일 한국 드라마를 보더니 한국어 실력이 많이 늘었어요.
forms.exampleMeaning: My younger sibling watched Korean dramas every day, and their Korean got much better.

forms.when: You share something you saw or experienced as background for a suggestion, request, or question. With a noun, use 이던데.
forms.example: 그 식당 김치찌개가 맛있던데 점심에 같이 갈래요?
forms.exampleMeaning: The kimchi stew at that restaurant was good (when I had it). Do you want to go there for lunch?

forms.when: You compare what you saw before with how things are now, or with what someone else said.
forms.example: 작년에는 이 가게에 손님이 많던데 요즘은 별로 없네요.
forms.exampleMeaning: This shop had lots of customers last year, but it doesn't have many these days.

watchOut: 제가 많이 걷더니 다리가 아파요 (X) → 형이 많이 걷더니 다리가 아픈지 쉬고 있어요 (O): -더니 tells what you saw someone or something else do. Do not use it with 제가 / 내가 for your own actions.
비가 오더니 우산을 가져가세요 (X) → 비가 오던데 우산을 가져가세요 (O): The part after -더니 tells what happened. To make a request or suggestion, use -던데.
학생더니 / 휴일던데 (X) → 학생이더니 / 휴일이던데 (O): After a noun, add 이: 이더니, 이던데.
exercises: Choose the right form: 아까 편의점에 우유가 (없더니 / 없던데) 마트에 가 볼까요?
Choose the right form: 친구가 요즘 매일 운동을 (하더니 / 하던데) 살이 많이 빠졌어요.
Change the noun in brackets using the ending given: ① 옆집 아이가 작년에는 (초등학생 + -더니) ____ 벌써 중학생이 됐네요. ② 그 가게 오늘 (휴일 + -던데) ____ 내일 가요.
Is the sentence natural? Write O or X: ① 형이 요즘 일찍 자더니 아침마다 운동을 해요. ② 제가 요즘 일찍 자더니 아침마다 운동을 해요. ③ 길이 많이 막히더니 지하철을 타세요.
Join the two sentences with -던데: 아까 보니까 마트에서 사과가 쌌어요. / 좀 사 갈까요?
Join the two sentences with -더니: 선배가 1년 동안 열심히 준비했어요. / 결국 시험에 붙었어요.
answers: ① O ② X ③ X (③ 길이 많이 막히던데 지하철을 타세요.)
아까 보니까 마트에서 사과가 싸던데 좀 사 갈까요?
선배가 1년 동안 열심히 준비하더니 결국 시험에 붙었어요.
